ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 80% high-intensity (white) pixels centrally to 20% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels concentrated at the perimeter and in discrete focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity band along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; discrete dark geometric blobs (mottling) clustered in the medial regions of both lobes, including a distinct grouping of small spots on the inner left lobe and larger focal points near the central-right margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 135 degrees; notch depth is clearly defined against the lighter interior fluke region.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-6 pixel peaks) detected along the entire trailing edge; topography becomes more irregular and jagged toward the distal terminals of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curvature extending from the median notch to the distal tips, showing a gradual tapering sweep toward the outer lobe margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 10-12 discrete, circular dark pixel clusters (diameter 3-7 pixels) scattered across the white ventral surface, representing potential barnacle attachment scars.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least 3 distinct, parallel, near-vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) on the middle-left lobe, cutting through the primary white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel linear rake marks on the left lobe; irregular jagged tissue loss on the far-left and far-right distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Symmetrical dark pigment patches localized immediately superior to the vertex of the median notch.
